subject: Mike Mastrobuoni School Committee Campaign
overview: Danielle Balocca interviewed School Committee candidate Mike Mastrobuoni on the Medford Bytes podcast to discuss his background and platform. Mastrobuoni highlighted his professional municipal finance experience and outlined his vision for the district's budget and infrastructure.

items.title: Introduction and Medford Food Favorites
items.summary: Hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan introduced the podcast, and Balocca welcomed candidate Mike Mastrobuoni to share his background and favorite local eateries.

items.title: Motivation to Run
items.summary: Mastrobuoni discussed moving to Medford in 2021, raising two children in the public school system, and wanting to use his skills to support the community.

items.title: Municipal Finance Professional Experience
items.summary: Mastrobuoni detailed his role as the budget director for the City of Somerville and how managing a municipal budget prepares him for school committee oversight.

items.title: Current School District Assessment and Budgeting
items.summary: Mastrobuoni praised recent labor negotiations and override successes while emphasizing the need to translate complex school budget data into clear resident communication.

items.title: Medford High School Building Project
items.summary: Mastrobuoni drew on his experience with Somerville's high school renovation to discuss planning, accessibility, energy efficiency, and securing a debt exclusion for Medford High School.

items.title: Risk Mitigation and Strategic Planning
items.summary: Mastrobuoni raised concerns about potential state or federal funding cuts and emphasized the importance of planning ahead and hiring a values-aligned superintendent.

items.title: Progressive Values and Local Endorsements
items.summary: Mastrobuoni identified as a strong progressive running in alignment with Our Revolution Medford to address local challenges.

items.title: Campaign Platform and Contact Details
items.summary: Mastrobuoni summarized his platform priorities, including well-resourced classrooms, fair teacher compensation, and in-district special education, before sharing his campaign's contact info.
